# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen years old by the end of Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** Student / Teacher-in-training  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student preparing for Regent's Entrance Exam  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

She is described as overweight and heavy-set, a physical trait that renders her unsuitable for delicate roles in school plays.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, arrogant, and dishonest, frequently mocking others while boasting about her family's wealth. She holds a strong antipathy toward Nell Harcourt, constantly attempting to undermine and demean her. Despite her boastful nature, she is insecure about her academic standing and prone to bitter jealousy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P8](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0008), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)_

- Spiteful and caustic-tongued  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>

- Skilled at walking wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To excel over her peers and humiliate Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c32 P33](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0033)</sub>
- To gain an education for status rather than livelihood  <sub>[v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. She frequently displayed dishonest behavior, such as peeking at her book during a spelling class. When Nell was punished by being forced to stand at the blackboard, Flossie took spiteful delight in her classmate's shame. Flossie challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of the Pembroke kitchen roof, a dangerous dare that resulted in Nell falling and spraining her ankle. During Nell's recovery, Flossie visited her out of guilt and fear of being blamed for a fatal accident. She joined the Regent's Entrance preparation class, boasting that she did so merely for an education since her family's wealth meant she did not need to work. She became moody when she was passed over for the role of Fairy Queen in a Christmas play due to her heavy frame. Later, she barely passed the Entrance Examination and attended Regent's Academy, where she continued her rivalry with Nell and eventually planned to return to college for further study rather than teach.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P12](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0012), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
